context.guidance: Compare deltas within their input program and protocol. Group winner is not promotion. A single validation observation is configuration-specific evidence, not a general causal rule. Timeout is incomplete evidence at its recorded cap; repaired attempts do not erase earlier failures. Jump acceptance includes four retune rounds and gives no isolated component attribution. Rolled-back basin records remain historical observations, not the current incumbent. AST identity detects source duplicates, not functional equivalence. Identical checkpoints alone do not prove identical predictions.
